headline: Sensex and Nifty end flat amid elevated crude prices and caution ahead of US Fed rate decision

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty closed flat as caution prevailed ahead of the US Federal Reserve policy decision.
Higher crude oil prices and Middle East geopolitical tensions capped upside gains.
FPIs remained net buyers in the Indian equity market, purchasing shares worth ₹4,240 crore.
Sectoral gains and strong performance in the Midcap index (up 565 points) provided support to the market.
whatHappening: Major Indian companies including HUL, Hyundai Motors, Vedanta, Bandhan Bank, and United Spirits are reporting Q2 results today.
Infosys received four analyst downgrades in a single day following a weaker annual sales outlook.
US stocks ended higher driven by an AI rally on the Nasdaq ahead of the Fed interest rate verdict.
IMD issued warnings for Cyclone Arnab as states move quickly to evacuate coastal populations.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices closed flat as elevated crude prices and geopolitical concerns offset sectoral gains ahead of the US Fed rate decision.
Foreign portfolio investors were net buyers of ₹4,240 crore, providing underlying market strength alongside a rally in midcap stocks.
Focus remains on key Q2 earnings declarations today from major names including HUL, Hyundai Motors, and Vedanta, while Infosys faces downgrades.
